id.description: Pack identity, e.g. exercises, templates, translations, evidence, icons, body-maps, achievements, exercise-images, formulas, food-offline, app-config, exercise-videos

version.description: SemVer of this pack build (monotonic for a given id)

channel.description: baseline = ships inside app binaries; update = signed CDN override newer than bundled; media = optional on-demand; off = Open Food Facts offline; config = remote flags with bundled defaults

minAppVersion.description: Minimum OmniGart app SemVer that may apply this pack

maxAppVersion.description: Optional exclusive upper bound; omit for open-ended

baselineVersion.description: For channel=update: the bundled baseline version this pack may replace. App applies only if installed baseline ≤ this and pack.version > installed override (or baseline).

contentEpoch.description: Stable id of the content source tree (e.g. git tree hash of content/). Same epoch for baseline + update built from one pipeline run.

locale.description: BCP-47 locale when the pack is language-specific

bundlePath.description: Relative path inside the app bundle where baseline assets are expected (channel=baseline)

sizeBudgetBytes.description: Declared budget for this pack; CI fails if archive.size exceeds it for baseline channel
